_comment: INPUT decision file (not a result). Lists raw-data defects the user approved for exclusion. Scripts may exclude ONLY tuples listed here; any other unpairable tuple aborts the run (HARD RULE 6).
decision: Exclude unpairable capture tuples from the 4-stream wide manifest (Phase 3) and therefore from all Phase 4 modes, so rgb / spectral / fusion runs see identical data. The files remain in per-stream quality and claims audits - they are valid images - and are never deleted or renamed on disk (HARD RULE 2).
evidence: 40716 files = 4 streams x 10179; 10180 capture tuples; 10178 have all 4 streams. The 2 exceptions are complementary (plant 14: 34 RGB / 33 spectral images overall; plant 17: 27 RGB / 28 spectral). Filenames cannot distinguish 'one misnamed file' from 'two independently missing captures', so no pairing is guessed.

exclusions.reason: RGB image exists; its three spectral counterparts do not.
Spectral triplet exists; its RGB counterpart does not.
